question: Filter the BAM file to keep only reads with a mapping quality of 30 or above.

files.eval_guideline: Read records must match the reference; BAM header and optional-tag order may differ.
files.match_reasoning: Both files have the same name, example_tumor_filtered.bam, and the same BAM format. The .bai file is only an index, so it isn't the match.
files.strategy_reasoning: A deterministic MAPQ≥30 filter must keep the same reads as the reference. The guideline allows header and tag-order differences, so matching reads by name (approximate, with min_mapq=0 so every read counts and full overlap required) fits better than bit-identical exact matching.
